items.title: Fed’s hawkish rate hold keeps pressure on Bitcoin: Analysts
items.snippet: Traders are pricing in a 78% chance of a December rate hike, while analysts say Treasury yields, the US dollar and upcoming inflation data could determine Bitcoin’s next move.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо BTC -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.
